purpose: Hot state for recurring XerahS hourly review selection. Keep this file small and machine-readable; archive raw detail separately.
selection_rules: Read this JSON first, then the short current tracker only if human context is needed.
Prefer the stalest high-priority area that is not blocked by a larger prerequisite.
After a run, update the matching area, prepend one compact last_runs item, and archive detailed evidence by log path only.
Do not paste full build/test output into hot state or the current tracker.

areas.area: MCP server / IsHistorySearchResourceUri prefix and malformed query hardening
areas.source: follow-up from MCP search resource URI edge cases (next_candidates[0])
areas.last_outcome: Hardened XerahSMcpRuntime.IsHistorySearchResourceUri against two classes of bad input that previously slipped through: (1) prefix-only paths like 'xerahs://history/searchfoo' that were incorrectly treated as search URIs (matched by StartsWith, not exact path or path+query); (2) malformed percent-escapes in the query (e.g. 'q=%E0%A4%A') that left Uri.UnescapeDataString in a half-decoded state. The fix uses a Uri-based parse to confirm the Host is 'history', the AbsolutePath is exactly '/history/search', and only valid percent-escapes (each '%' followed by two hex digits) are passed to unescape. The 'IsHistorySearchResourceUri' method is now public static (previously private/internal) so tests can call it directly without reflection. Added 7 regression tests (3 valid + 4 invalid inputs). Bumped version 0.23.100 -> 0.23.101.
areas.follow_up: Resume other follow-up tracks: OCR tool/onboarding language-selection parity, Uploader UI/log diagnostics for stale default cleanup and unavailable provider replacement flows, CLI xerahscli upload --pipe edge cases, history backup user-visible diagnostics. Clawpatch queue: FileDownloader chunked/streaming-encoding support, plugin version pinning, TFM mismatch in Common/Platform.Abstractions. Pre-existing SQLite 'disk I/O error' (now affecting 5 tests including 2 new IsHistorySearchResourceUri fixtures) is environmental, documented in next_candidates.

areas.last_outcome: Fixed LinuxCliToolRunner.RunAsync pipe-drain deadlock. Spawned child process had RedirectStandardError/Output=true but the pipes were never drained, so the OS pipe buffer (~64KB on POSIX) could fill and block the child on its next write, causing WaitForExit to time out and the capture to return a misleading null/failure even though the tool was healthy. Same anti-pattern previously fixed in MacOSClipboardService, LinuxClipboardService, and the MacOS AppleScript helpers. Fix: extracted RunCoreAsync that drains stderr via process.BeginErrorReadLine and stdout via a fire-and-forget ReadToEndAsync continuation; added a bounded process.WaitForExit(1000) after Kill so the async drainers finish reading the (now-broken) pipes before the using block disposes the process. Added internal TestAccessor exposing RunForTestAsync so tests can exercise the run helper without producing a real PNG. Added 4 regression tests: happy path, large-stderr 0-exit, large-stderr non-zero exit, and timeout. Bumped version 0.23.85 -> 0.23.86.
areas.follow_up: Continue clawpatch queue: FileDownloader chunked/streaming-encoding support (declared-length read/write loop wrapped the entire download and dropped 0-byte response bodies on chunked transfers — fixed locally in v0.23.84 commit 15a5773a but push deferred from prior run). Then continue TFM mismatch in Common/Platform.Abstractions, plugin version pinning, and remaining capture pipeline edge cases.

last_runs.area: MCP server / CreateHistoryDetailsAsync stale local path diagnostic
last_runs.summary: Fixed CreateHistoryDetailsAsync silent stale-path gap: when item.FilePath was set but the file was not on disk, the response silently returned null width/height, null MD5 hash, and a 0-byte file_size with no indication that the file was missing. MCP clients could not distinguish 'image is being processed' from 'the stored capture path is stale'. Made CreateHistoryDetailsAsync internal (InternalsVisibleTo already in place) and added explicit file_exists (bool), file_missing_path (string|null), and thumbnail_exists (bool) fields. file_exists is computed once up front; hash/size/dimension block only runs when the source file is genuinely on disk. file_missing_path is null when FilePath is empty (no missing path to surface) and equals item.FilePath otherwise. thumbnail_exists uses the same TryResolveLocalFilePath check as CreateHistoryBlobResourceUriIfLocal. Added 3 regression tests. Bumped version 0.23.89 -> 0.23.90.
last_runs.result: build 0 warnings/0 errors; XerahS.Tests 1066 passed/0 failed/1 skipped; XerahS.McpServer.Tests 40 passed/0 failed (was 37, +3 new)

last_runs.area: MCP server / ResolveHistoryBlobPath misleading error message
last_runs.summary: ResolveHistoryBlobPath threw 'History item thumbnail source file was not found.' with item.FilePath as FileName even when both the thumbnail and the source were missing, or when only the source was configured. Fix: branch the exception message on which fields are populated — 'thumbnail and source files were not found.' when both present, 'source file was not found.' when only FilePath configured, original 'thumbnail source file was not found.' when only ThumbnailURL configured. FileName preserved as item.FilePath to keep prior contract for debug-log consumers. CreateHistoryBlobMissingResponse already uses item.FilePath / item.ThumbnailURL directly, so the structured-response path is unaffected. Added 3 regression tests (MissingThumbnailOnly_FallsBackToSourceFile, MissingBothFiles_MentionsThumbnailAndSource, OnlyThumbnailConfiguredMissing_KeepsThumbnailOnlyMessage). Bumped version 0.23.88 -> 0.23.89.

last_runs.area: Wayland / Linux CLI capture / LinuxCliToolRunner pipe-drain deadlock
last_runs.summary: Fixed LinuxCliToolRunner.RunAsync pipe-drain deadlock: spawned child process with RedirectStandardError/Output=true but pipes were never drained, so OS pipe buffer could fill and block the child on its next write. Extracted RunCoreAsync with BeginErrorReadLine + fire-and-forget ReadToEndAsync; added bounded process.WaitForExit(1000) after Kill so async drainers finish reading the (now-broken) pipes before the using block disposes the process. Added internal TestAccessor exposing RunForTestAsync; added 4 regression tests (happy path, large-stderr 0-exit, large-stderr non-zero exit, timeout). Bumped version 0.23.85 -> 0.23.86.
